title: release-verdict
description: Structured output contract for a hermetic Claude release analysis (claude -p --bare --output-format json --json-schema this-file). The agent ANALYZES and reports; it does not mutate. The pipeline gates on `verdict`.

verdict.description: approve only when every gate clears; block on the strongest objection (fail-closed).

blockers.description: One human-readable line per failed gate. Empty iff verdict is approve.

readiness_probe_path.description: The readiness probe path as RENDERED from Helm values — a claim about the app.

app_routes.description: The routes the app actually serves — the executable ground truth the probe path is checked against.

max_unavailable.description: Rendered rollout maxUnavailable — 100% means no serving floor.
